name: slider
description:
A draggable single- or range-value slider, horizontal or vertical, built from parts. Pass an array default/value to get one thumb per value.

- **`Slider`**: holds the value and `limit`, a cap below `maxValue` (stock left, plan quota): the scale and marks still run to `maxValue`, the track above the limit is drawn as unavailable and its marks are disabled. Without children it draws just the track and thumb (name it with `aria-label`).
- **`SliderLabel`** names it (a `FieldLabel` works too); **`SliderValue`** prints the value (or range), formatted by its `children` ("200 orders") or by `formatOptions` (currency, percent — also what screen readers announce).
- **`SliderControl`** lays out **`SliderTrack`** (with **`SliderFill`**, the selected part) and **`SliderThumb`**, which draws one thumb per value and takes `children` (an icon, a logo).
- **`SliderMarks`**: labelled stops under the track (`number` or `{ value, label }`). Clicking one moves the nearest thumb there and fires `onChangeEnd`, while the keyboard keeps using the thumb.
- **`SliderDescription`**: under the track, says why, and is read with the value.

Every part takes a `className`, for a branded look (a gradient fill, a bigger thumb).
